newsitem.title: USA: Search committee urged to find Hi-Lo buyer.
newsitem.headline: Search committee urged to find Hi-Lo buyer.

text.p: Hwang Family Ltd Partnership said Thursday it proposed to Hi-Lo Automotive Inc that a committee be formed to search for a potential buyer of the company.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the partnership also said it has placed in nomination two names as directors of the company to be voted on the 1997 annual meeting of shareholders.

The managing partner of the Hwang Family partnership has accepted a nomination as a director of the company, the filing said. Hwang Family holds a 9.8 percent stake in Hi-Lo Automotive or 1,051,950 common shares.
Hi-Lo, based in Houston, Texas, is a retailer of automotive parts and acessories serving both the do-it-yourself consumer and commercial repair outlets.
